CheckOutcome.description:
Outcome of one check. `NotApplicable` checks are left out of the score
denominator; `NotAssessed` checks cannot be evaluated yet (e.g. they
need a plugin that ships later) and are shown honestly, never as passes.

CheckResult.description: One evaluated check; the score is computed from these (spec §5.4).

ComplianceStatus.description:
The state of one control after evaluation. `NotAssessed` is never a
pass: a control with a missing, stale or unknown check lands here, so
a report that cannot prove a control never claims it.

Severity.description: Finding severity. Weights drive the posture score (spec §5.4).

description: One control's verdict and the checks that decided it.

title.description: The control's own wording, so the report stands alone.
